answer: Yes, this is a real bug. Root cause: sim/simulator.go:647 incremented TotalOutputTokens inline during every decode step in executeBatchStep(). When a request is preempted (sim/batch_formation.go:232 resets ProgressIndex to 0), it re-enters the batch and re-decodes from scratch, causing the same output tokens to be counted again. Fix: removed the inline TotalOutputTokens++ from executeBatchStep and moved the accounting to recordRequestCompletion(), where it computes output tokens as (ProgressIndex - len(InputTokens)). Since ProgressIndex is reset on preemption, only the final attempt's tokens are counted. With the fix, both the small-KV (preemption) and large-KV (no preemption) runs report identical total_output_tokens (105,082) for the same 200 requests.
